remarks: Welcome to 6221and 6223 Citrus Ave. A rare and versatile property that’s perfect for a multi-family, an investor looking for a duplex as a rental property for a homeowner that would like to live in home and rent out the other. The front, 948 square foot single-story, 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom house has been fully remodeled giving it the appearance of a new home. The rear two-story home was built in 1988 with 1,290 square feet featuring 3-bedrooms and 2.5-bathrooms. Both homes have their own 2 car garages, plus plenty of additional on-site parking including room for RV parking. These homes are both in “turn-key” condition and ready  for immediate occupancy.
